description: This file contains functions for checking and performing system upgrades, including partition verification, copying configurations, and writing images to devices. It is part of a Linux system upgrade process tailored for the OMAP platform.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image's partition layout matches the existing device, and prompts the user if a full image write is required due to layout changes.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the mounted partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade by writing images to the device, handling partition layout changes, and updating UUIDs.
